lines.en: Joey is having a Secret Days of Our Lives party up on the roof,
and he sent you guys to the play to get rid of you.
What?
What? What's going on?
Joey is having a Secret Days of Our Lives party up on the roof.
And he didn't want you guys to know about it,
but I came over here to tell you.
I thought he came to say you were sick.
All right, professor or detective?
Joey's having a party, and he wasn't going to invite us?
Yeah, he does it every year.
That's why he's sending you to the play?
That's why he sent us to that medieval restaurant?
And to that button factory?
And that horrible museum tour?
No, I arranged that.
Hey, you guys, I'm turning in.
Have fun.
You know about your party, Joey.
What party?
The game's over.
Take off your robe.
Very, I mean...
